import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# read images

img_3 = mpimg.imread('figures/T7/example3_ring.png')

# create subplot axis
fig, axs = plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,11))

# plot the images
axs[0].imshow(img_1)
axs[1].imshow(img_2)
axs[2].imshow(img_3)

# turn off the axis
